summary: This bill doubles the death gratuity paid to survivors of deceased service members from $100,000 to $200,000 and mandates annual cost-of-living adjustments to this amount based on the Consumer Price Index.

scores.thoughts: This bill increases the death gratuity for members of the Armed Forces and provides for annual cost-of-living adjustments. This directly relates to military benefits and compensation, which falls under military spending, increasing it slightly.
